item.title: iPhone 17 & 18 Pro Cases: Are They Interchangeable?
item.description: Apple says iPhone 17 Pro cases won’t fit iPhone 18 Pro due to a 0.1 mm camera plateau change, yet testing shows they’re interchangeable in real‑world use.
